message.changed_tsc.no_ammo: Out of ammo! Craft TSC Bullets.
message.changed_tsc.first_aid_disabled: First aid is disabled in the config.
message.changed_tsc.boss_failed: The boss could not be summoned (is Changed installed? try /tsc resolve).
tooltip.changed_tsc.first_aid: Cures harmful effects. Right-click others to treat them.
tooltip.changed_tsc.summon: Use on the ground to summon: %s
tooltip.changed_tsc.syringe: Removes ALL goo from the body (causes nausea)
message.changed_tsc.goo.stage1: You feel goo inside your body... (Stage 1: Goo Inside Body)
message.changed_tsc.goo.stage2: Fur and goo are spreading over your skin! (Stage 2: Furry Body)
message.changed_tsc.goo.stage3: You are transfurring! Use a First Aid Kit or Anti-Goo Syringe NOW! (Stage 3)
message.changed_tsc.goo.feel1: Something cold is moving under your skin...
message.changed_tsc.goo.feel2: Your arms itch. Soft fur is growing where the goo touched you...
message.changed_tsc.goo.feel3: Your thoughts feel... squishy. Your body is not human anymore...
message.changed_tsc.goo.cured: The goo is gone. Your body is human again.
message.changed_tsc.goo.clean: There is no goo in your body.
death.attack.changed_tsc.goo_transfur.pl: %1$s was transfurred by the goo while fighting %2$s
settings.changed_tsc.title: Thunder Science Company Settings
settings.changed_tsc.multiplayer_note: Multiplayer: the server's config file decides these rules.
settings.changed_tsc.remove_vanilla_host: Removes Minecraft's own hostile mobs (zombies, skeletons, creepers, spiders...). Latex and TSC mobs stay.
settings.changed_tsc.remove_vanilla_boss: Also removes the Ender Dragon, Wither, Elder Guardian and Warden. Needs "No Vanilla Monsters" on. The End fight cannot happen while this is on.
settings.changed_tsc.latex_hunt_humans.t: Hostile latex go after TSC guards, scientists and staff.
settings.changed_tsc.npcs_fight_monsters: Guards and staff also fight vanilla monsters, not only latex.
settings.changed_tsc.scientists_heal.tip: Scientists use first aid on hurt players, humans and Puro nearby.
settings.changed_tsc.guns_require_ammo.t: Guns use TSC Bullets from your inventory.
settings.changed_tsc.menu_button.tip: Show the TSC Settings button on the title screen and pause menu. The settings key and the Mods list still open this screen.
settings.changed_tsc.stealth_enabled.tip: While you sneak, latex do not notice you unless you are close.
settings.changed_tsc.stealth_vs_bosses.t: Bosses can also be fooled by sneaking.
How close (in blocks) a latex must be to notice a sneaking player.
settings.changed_tsc.sneak_visibility.ti: How visible a sneaking player is to latex. Lower is harder to see.
settings.changed_tsc.darkness_multiplier: Notice range is multiplied by this when you stand in the dark. Lower is stealthier.
settings.changed_tsc.goo_enabled.tip: Latex hits put goo inside your body: Goo Inside Body, then Furry Body, then Transfur.
settings.changed_tsc.goo_symptoms.tip: Hunger, slowness, weakness, nausea, darkness and the feeling messages for each stage.
settings.changed_tsc.goo_infect_humans.t: Guards, scientists and staff can be infected and turn into latex.
settings.changed_tsc.goo_body_overlay.ti: Show goo and fur spreading over the body.
settings.changed_tsc.goo_per_hit.tip: Infection added by each latex hit.
settings.changed_tsc.goo_furry_at.tip: Infection level where the human body starts to become a furry body.
settings.changed_tsc.goo_transfurring_at: Infection level where the last stage starts. At 100% you transfur.
settings.changed_tsc.goo_spread_stage2.t: How fast the goo spreads by itself during Furry Body.
settings.changed_tsc.goo_spread_stage3.t: How fast the goo spreads by itself during Transfurring.
settings.changed_tsc.first_aid_enabled.t: TSC First Aid Kits and Bandages can be used.
settings.changed_tsc.first_aid_cures_eff: A First Aid Kit removes harmful effects.
settings.changed_tsc.kit_heal.tip: Health restored by a First Aid Kit (2 = one heart).
settings.changed_tsc.bandage_heal.tip: Health restored by a Bandage (2 = one heart).
settings.changed_tsc.kit_goo_cure.tip: Goo infection removed by a First Aid Kit.
settings.changed_tsc.bandage_goo_cure.ti: Goo infection removed by a Bandage.
settings.changed_tsc.first_aid_mod.missi: First Aid mod: not installed (these 4 do nothing)
settings.changed_tsc.fa_mod_compat.tip: Work together with the First Aid mod. TSC kits then heal your hurt body parts through that mod.
settings.changed_tsc.fa_mod_loot.tip: The First Aid mod's bandages, plasters and morphine appear in TSC chests and drop from scientists and bosses. Chests need /reload.
settings.changed_tsc.fa_mod_morphine.tip: While the First Aid mod's morphine works, the goo stops spreading and you do not feel its symptoms.
settings.changed_tsc.fa_mod_only.tip: TSC kits and bandages only remove goo. Health is healed only with the First Aid mod's own items.
settings.changed_tsc.puro_enabled.tip: Puro never attacks players or TSC humans.
settings.changed_tsc.puro_fight.tip: Puro attacks hostile latex and monsters.
settings.changed_tsc.puro_retaliate.tip: If you hit Puro, he fights back.
settings.changed_tsc.puro_hint: Spawn one with /tsc puro. Any mob with the tag changed_tsc_friendly is friendly.
settings.changed_tsc.bosses_enabled.tip: Boss altars in structures and boss summon items work.
settings.changed_tsc.max_minions.tip: How many helpers a boss keeps alive around itself.
settings.changed_tsc.boss_health.tip: Health of this boss the next time it is spawned (2 = one heart).
settings.changed_tsc.bosses_hint: Boss entities and damage are set in config/changed_tsc-common.toml.
message.changed_tsc.boss.squid_shield: Squid dogs shield %s with metal plates! Defeat the shield bearers first.
message.changed_tsc.boss.squid_self_hit: %s hit itself with its own tentacle!
message.changed_tsc.boss.squid_release: %s lets go of the Tiger Shark!
message.changed_tsc.boss.shark_lines: %s calls two lines of sharks. Do not stand in the middle!
message.changed_tsc.boss.wolf_howl: %s howls for his pack. He is protected while two wolves stand with him.
settings.changed_tsc.doll_hud.tip: Show a small body figure on screen that marks where the goo is. It appears when there is goo in your body or you are transfurred.
settings.changed_tsc.doll_always.tip: Keep the doll on screen even while your body is fully human.
settings.changed_tsc.doll_paws.tip: Mark hands and feet with a paw print once they have turned into paws.
settings.changed_tsc.doll_changed.tip: Also show the Changed mod's own transfur progress on the doll (whichever is higher).
settings.changed_tsc.doll_position.tip: Where the doll sits on screen. The First Aid mod puts its own figure top left by default.
settings.changed_tsc.doll_scale.tip: Size of the doll on the HUD.
settings.changed_tsc.doll_hint: Press %s in game to open the body screen and clear goo.
screen.changed_tsc.body.title: Your Body
screen.changed_tsc.body.hint.human: No goo. Your body is clean.
screen.changed_tsc.body.hint.inside: Goo is inside. Clear it early.
screen.changed_tsc.body.hint.furry: Your hands are paws. It spreads.
screen.changed_tsc.body.bandage.tip: Use one Bandage from your inventory: small heal, removes a little goo.
screen.changed_tsc.body.kit.tip: Use one First Aid Kit from your inventory: big heal, cures harmful effects, removes a lot of goo.
screen.changed_tsc.body.syringe.tip: Use one Anti-Goo Syringe from your inventory: clears all goo. Causes nausea for a moment.
screen.changed_tsc.body.part.head: Head
settings.changed_tsc.furniture_changed.t: Furnish structures with the Changed mod's own lab tables, office chairs, computers, microscopes and boxes. Off uses plain vanilla blocks. Only affects structures you have not visited yet.
